bench.app.title: Obligarth Bench — Android enrollment
bench.session.none: No bench session: a technician opens one in the console before any enrollment.
bench.adb.missingTitle: ADB is not installed on this station
bench.adb.license: The station downloads Google platform-tools {{version}} (adb.exe and its two DLLs only) from dl.google.com and checks its SHA-256. By continuing you accept the Android SDK licence.
bench.adb.zipPlaceholder: or the path of a platform-tools zip
bench.adb.conflictHelp: Close the other ADB tool (Android Studio, scrcpy, a Samsung tool…): Windows lets one process only hold a USB device.
bench.adb.listener: An ADB server listens on port 5037.
bench.adb.stopConfirm: Stop the other ADB processes? Unsaved work in those tools may be lost.
bench.adb.smartSwitch: Samsung Smart Switch is running: close it, it holds the phones.
bench.adb.driver: Windows has no driver yet for the Samsung phone plugged in. Leave it plugged in for a minute (Windows Update installs it by itself), then unplug it and plug it back.
bench.adb.keyProfile: ADB keeps its key in your Windows profile (%USERPROFILE%\.android), shared with any other ADB tool of this account. After the theft of this PC, also revoke the USB debugging authorizations on the devices.
bench.url.title: Address of Obligarth
bench.url.help: The address of the Obligarth console, for example https://obligarth.example.test. The installer usually sets it.
bench.station.pendingTitle: This station awaits the approval of a platform administrator
bench.station.pendingHelp: Station « {{name}} ». In the console, Bench stations, the administrator types this code again (the name proves nothing):
bench.station.suspended: This station is suspended: nothing can be done on a device until it is resumed in the console.
bench.station.revoked: This station is revoked: its token is refused for good.
bench.station.renewHelp: Renew it: a new token (and a new ADB key of the station) is drawn and must be approved again.
bench.cards.empty: Plug a device by USB, with USB debugging enabled, and accept the fingerprint of this PC on its screen (« Always allow »).
bench.cards.abandonConfirm: Abandon this provisioning? It is closed on the server.
bench.cards.releaseConfirm: This station set the agent as owner of the device and it is not enrolled. Give the device back (remove the owner and the administrator)? Otherwise only a factory reset removes it.
bench.prompt.choose_target: Choose the target of this device.
bench.prompt.device_unauthorized: On the phone, screen unlocked: accept the « Allow USB debugging? » window, ticking « Always allow from this computer », then Retry. No window? Unplug and plug the cable back, choose the USB mode « File transfer », or leave the former kiosk.
bench.prompt.device_offline: The device is offline: unplug it, use a data cable, then Retry.
bench.prompt.adb_conflict: Another ADB tool holds the device: close it (banner above), then Retry.
bench.prompt.device_gone: Device unplugged: plug the SAME device back, the card resumes.
bench.prompt.station_refused: The station is not approved ({{reason}}): nothing more is done on the device.
bench.prompt.server_unreachable: Obligarth does not answer: the steps are kept and sent again. Retry.
bench.prompt.redirected: The address answers with a redirection, not followed: fix the address of the station.
bench.prompt.owner_blocked: The agent cannot become the owner of this device yet:
bench.prompt.owner_failed: Setting the owner failed; the administrator state was read back.
bench.prompt.confirm_admin_sdk35: Android 15 or later: as device administrator, Knox refuses app installation and the uninstall lock. Confirm the administrator anyway?
bench.prompt.play_protect: Play Protect checks the agent: tap « Install anyway » on the device, then Retry.
bench.prompt.install_restricted: Installation is restricted on this device (a policy, or MobiControl): suspend the policy or move the device to another group, then Retry.
bench.prompt.no_session: No bench session is open: a technician opens one in the console, then Retry.
bench.prompt.token_rejected: The agent refused the enrollment token: Reissue a token.
bench.prompt.enroll_timeout: No enrollment within 3 minutes: check the network and the time of the device, then Reissue a token.
bench.prompt.accountApps: Carried by: {{owners}} — sign out in the app or uninstall it, put the accounts back after.
bench.blocker.accounts: Accounts on the device: Settings > Accounts (Google, Samsung), or sign out in the app that carries them.
bench.blocker.extra_users: Other users or profiles: remove Secure Folder, Dual Messenger, Private space, the work profile and the guest.
bench.blocker.foreign_owner: Another app owns the device: a factory reset is needed.
bench.blocker.profile_owner: A profile owner exists (work profile, Secure Folder): remove it.
bench.blocker.owner_failed: Android refused the owner for another reason (see the raw log).
bench.choice.continueAdminConfirm: Continue as device administrator instead of device owner?
bench.choice.confirmAdminConfirm: Android 15+: Knox is restricted for an administrator. Continue as administrator anyway?
bench.hint.old_android_dialog: Android 14+: if « This app was built for an older version of Android » shows, tap OK.
bench.hint.adb_cut_pending: ADB switched off: awaiting the confirmation of the agent (adbEnabled).
bench.hint.network_error: The agent cannot reach Obligarth: check the network of the device.
bench.hint.clock: The clock of the device is wrong: set the date and time.
bench.hint.link_lost: The agent lost its link to Obligarth.
bench.hint.resumed: An open provisioning of this device was resumed.
bench.hint.resumed_earlier: The preparation started earlier for this device was resumed as it was planned: its name and site are kept (see above), not those of this card.
bench.hint.name_taken: Another device of the tenant already has this name.
bench.hint.identity_conflict: A device of the tenant managed by another channel has this serial.
bench.update.available: Version {{version}} of the station is available.
bench.history.title: Today on this station
bench.error.adb_missing: ADB is missing or damaged on this station.
bench.error.adb_server: The ADB server of the station did not start.
bench.error.adb_conflict: Another ADB tool holds the devices.
bench.error.device_unauthorized: The device has not authorized this PC.
bench.error.auto_blocker_suspected: Auto Blocker seems active: Settings > Security and privacy > Auto Blocker: off.
bench.error.adb_blocked_by_policy: USB debugging is blocked by a policy (Knox or MobiControl): move the device to a group without this restriction.
bench.error.unsupported_sdk: Android {{sdk}} is not supported (Android 7 or later).
bench.error.agent_foreign_signer: The agent on the device is not signed by Obligarth: nothing is uninstalled; remove it by hand or reset the device.
bench.error.agent_downgrade: A newer agent is installed than the one served to the bench.
bench.error.agent_already_enrolled: The agent of this device is enrolled elsewhere: revoke it in the console that manages it, or reset the device.
bench.error.install_failed: The installation of the agent failed.
bench.error.install_restricted: Installation is restricted on this device.
bench.error.apk_mismatch: The APK served does not match the pinned signer or its SHA-256: refused.
bench.error.owner_blocked: The agent cannot become the owner of this device.
bench.error.owner_failed: The device owner could not be set or confirmed.
bench.error.admin_failed: The device administrator could not be activated.
bench.error.admin_lost: The administrator was lost: open the agent on the device and activate it again.
bench.error.knox_reactivation: The Knox licence is being reactivated.
bench.error.enroll_timeout: The device did not enroll in time.
bench.error.identity_mismatch: The identity of the device does not match what the bench read: enrollment refused.
bench.error.device_outside_target: This device is managed in the tenant outside the target group: move it in the console first.
bench.error.station_refused: The station is refused by Obligarth.
bench.error.redirected: The address of Obligarth answers with a redirection (not followed).
bench.error.target_refused: This target is not (or no longer) one of the station.
bench.error.slot_held: This device already has a card.
bench.error.too_many_cards: Too many cards are open (16 at most): close finished ones.
bench.local.no_pin: This build has no pinned agent signer: no APK can be installed.
bench.local.clock: The clock of this PC is off by more than 5 minutes.
bench.local.apk_unavailable: No agent version is served to the bench: a platform administrator chooses one in the console.
bench.local.agent_too_old: The agent served to the bench is too old for this.
bench.local.station_ip_refused: The address of this PC is not allowed for the station.
bench.local.too_many_pending: Too many stations await their approval: try again later.
bench.local.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
bench.local.open_provisioning: This device already has an open provisioning.
bench.local.bad_state: The provisioning is not in a state that allows this.
bench.local.not_enrolled: The device is not enrolled yet.
bench.local.not_verified: The agent has not reported the owner role yet.
bench.local.url_locked: The address was set by the installer or the station is approved: it is not changed here.
bench.local.busy: An operation is running: wait for its result.
bench.local.steps_pending: The journal of the previous provisioning has not reached the server yet: try again once it is reachable.
bench.local.choice_not_offered: This choice is not offered now.
bench.local.abandon_first: Abandon the provisioning before closing the card.
bench.local.op_unknown: This request never reached the station: nothing was done.
bench.local.update_started: Windows Installer started: approve it, then relaunch the station.
bench.local.signature_running_unsigned: This station is not signed: update it by running the MSI by hand.
bench.local.signature_invalid: The update is not validly signed: refused.
bench.local.signature_not_pinned: The update is signed by an unknown certificate: refused.
bench.local.signature_unreadable: The signature of the update could not be read.
bench.local.hash_mismatch: The update does not match its SHA-256: refused.
bench.local.no_hash: The server gave no SHA-256: refused.
bench.local.refused_file: The server named another file: refused.
bench.local.stage_failed: The update could not be written to a temporary folder.
bench.local.msiexec_failed: Windows Installer could not be started.
bench.main.unhandled: An operation failed without being handled.
bench.main.alreadyRunning: The station is already open but does not answer. Close its window, then launch it again.
bench.main.serverFailed: The local server could not start: {{detail}}
bench.main.windowFailed: The window of the station could not open ({{detail}}). Launch it again; if it happens again, report it with bench-error.log from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Obligarth.
bench.main.neverOpened: The window never showed; the station stops. Launch it again.
bench.adb.usbUnseen: Samsung phone connected by USB but not seen by ADB: {{serials}}
bench.prompt.rate_limited: The token quota of this station is reached (120 per hour, 300 per day): wait, then Retry.
bench.prompt.adb_server: ADB does not answer (its server is restarting or busy): wait a moment, then Retry.
bench.choose.noTarget: This station has no target yet: a platform or client administrator adds one in the console.
bench.choose.searchSite: Search a site (code, name or city)…
bench.choose.noSite: This client has no site: choose the target.
bench.choose.withoutSiteHelp: Without site: choose the target. The device stays in the target's group and gets the name typed, or its prefix and serial.
bench.choose.moreSites: Only the first {{count}} sites are shown: refine the search.
bench.choose.chooseGroup: Choose the target of this site…
bench.choose.namesTitle: Names already used in this site ({{count}})
bench.choose.namesEmpty: No device in this site yet.
bench.choose.name: Name of the device
bench.choose.nameTaken: This name is already used in this site: choose another one.
bench.choose.legacy: Allow the owner with an agent older than 1.4.0 (exception decided at the bench, recorded in the audit)
bench.choose.legacyShort: Owner with an older agent allowed (decided at the bench)
bench.prompt.name_taken: The name {{name}} was taken meanwhile in this site. Choose another one (suggested: {{suggestedName}}), then Start.
bench.prompt.site_refused: This site is no longer one of the target: choose the site again.
bench.error.site_refused: This site is not (or no longer) one of the target.
bench.error.name_taken: This name is already used in this site.
bench.code.apps_unsupported: skipped: this server does not install apps at the bench
bench.code.not_enrolled: not listed: the device is no longer enrolled
bench.code.device_outside_target: not listed: the device is managed outside the target group
bench.code.target_refused: not listed: the target or the technician’s right is no longer valid
bench.error.app_older_sdk: The app needs a newer Android than this device’s (INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK).
bench.error.app_version_downgrade: A newer version of the app is already installed (INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE): it is never downgraded.
bench.error.app_update_incompatible: The app already on the device is signed by another key (INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE): uninstall it on the device, then complete the apps again.
bench.error.app_insufficient_storage: Not enough storage on the device (INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE): free some space, then complete the apps again.
bench.error.app_invalid_apk: The file of the app is not a valid APK for this device.
bench.error.app_download_failed: The download of the app failed.
bench.error.app_sha_mismatch: The file received does not match its SHA-256: not installed.
bench.error.app_signer_mismatch: The app is not signed by the signer known to the store: not installed.
bench.error.app_install_failed: The installation of the app failed.
bench.error.app_unavailable: The file of the app is not available on the server.
bench.error.device_not_found: No device of the targets of this station matches this phone (not enrolled in them, or no serial that can be compared).
bench.error.identity_ambiguous: Several devices of the targets match this phone: complete it from the console.
bench.local.apps_unsupported: This Obligarth server does not install apps at the bench yet: update it.
bench.local.apps_agent_absent: The agent is not installed on this phone: start a provisioning instead.
bench.local.apps_not_enrolled: The agent of this phone is not enrolled: start a provisioning instead.
bench.local.apps_open_provisioning: This phone has a provisioning under way on this station: close this card and press Start to resume it, or abandon it.
bench.hint.apps_not_listed: Obligarth lists no app for this device now (not enrolled, or outside the target): apps skipped.
bench.cards.appsUnsupported: Apps skipped: this server does not install apps at the bench.
bench.cards.completedReserved: Done with reservations: the device is enrolled, {{count}} app(s) not installed.
bench.cards.completedApps: Done: the required apps are installed.
bench.cards.completedAppsReserved: Done with reservations: {{count}} app(s) not installed.
bench.cards.completeAppsHelp: Phone already enrolled: install by ADB the apps its policy requires (a bench session is needed).
bench.cards.appsProof: Identity proven: {{pairs}} serial(s) matched, Android ID {{androidId}}.
